Triggered by specific situations.roman: Dimaagi mehnat (sochne-padhne) se pasina badh jata hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: Sweating gets better after mental effort or stress.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: दिमागी मेहनत से पसीना कम हो जाता है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Dimaagi mehnat se pasina kam ho jata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat between 7 a.m. and 12 noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 7 बजे से दोपहर 12 बजे तक पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 7 baje se dopehr 12 baje tak pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat around 9 a.m., after a bowel movement.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 9 बजे शौच के बाद पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 9 baje shauch ke baad pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat during physical effort in the late morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के पहले पहर में मेहनत करने पर पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke pehle pehr mein mehnat karne par pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat during sleep in the late morning hours.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के पहले पहर में नींद के दौरान पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke pehle pehr mein nind ke dauran pasina aata hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You sweat during your menstrual period in the late morning.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: सुबह के पहले पहर में माहवारी के दौरान पसीना आता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Subah ke pehle pehr mein mahwari ke dauran pasina aata hai.

General.en: Your sweating lasts a long time and continues even during fever-free periods.
General.hi: पसीना बुखार के बिना वाले समय में भी लंबे समय तक बना रहता है।
General.roman: Pasina bukhaar ke bina wale samay mein bhi lambe samay tak bna rehta hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You sweat before your menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी से पहले पसीना आता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari se pehle pasina aata hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You sweat during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान पसीना आता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat in the hours after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat ke baad pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat around 1 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 1 बजे पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat 1 baje pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, midnight, after, 2 a.m. to 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You sweat between 2 a.m. and 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 2 बजे से 3 बजे के बीच पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat 2 baje se 3 baje ke beech pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, midnight, after, 2 a.m., to 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You sweat between 2 a.m. and 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 2 बजे से सुबह 5 बजे तक पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat 2 baje se subah 5 baje tak pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat around 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 3 बजे पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat 3 baje pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, midnight, after, 3 a.m., during sleep
Linked to time of day.en: You sweat around 3 a.m. while asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 3 बजे नींद के दौरान पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat 3 baje nind ke dauran pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, midnight, after, 3 a.m., to 4 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You sweat around 3 a.m. and this continues until 4 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 3 बजे से दोपहर 4 बजे तक पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat 3 baje se dopahar 4 baje tak pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat around 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 4 बजे पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat 4 baje pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, midnight, after, 4 a.m., during sleep
Linked to time of day.en: You sweat around 4 a.m. while asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 4 बजे नींद के दौरान पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat 4 baje nind ke dauran pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat in the time just before midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat se pehle pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You start sweating at midnight and it continues through until morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को पसीना शुरू होता है और सुबह तक बना रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat ko pasina shuru hota hai aur subah tak bana rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat at midnight when you wake up.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को नींद खुलने पर पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat ko nind khulne par pasina aata hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Perspiration, midnight, lying on the back, while
Linked to posture/position.en: You sweat at midnight while lying on your back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: आधी रात को पीठ के बल लेटने पर पसीना आता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: aadhi raat ko pith ke bal letne par pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat between 5 a.m. and 6 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 5 बजे से 6 बजे के बीच पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah 5 baje se 6 baje ke beech pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat around 6 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 6 बजे पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah 6 baje pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat between 6 a.m. and 7 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 6 बजे से 7 बजे के बीच पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah 6 baje se 7 baje ke beech pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat in the morning while still in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बिस्तर में लेटे-लेटे पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah bistar mein lete-lete pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat on every other morning, not every day.
Linked to time of day.hi: हर दूसरी सुबह पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Har doosri subah pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat in the morning after feeling hot.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह गर्मी महसूस होने के बाद पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah garmi mehsus hone ke baad pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Morning sweating that continues until noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह पसीना शुरू होता है और दोपहर तक बना रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah pasina shuru hota hai aur dopahar tak bana rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, morning, restless night, after a
Linked to time of day.en: You sweat in the morning after a restless night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात भर बेचैनी रहने के बाद सुबह पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat bhar bechainee rehne ke baad subah pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat during sleep in the morning hours.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद के दौरान पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind ke dauran pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat at the moment of waking in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलने पर पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind khulne par pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat in the morning after you wake up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलने के बाद पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind khulne ke baad pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat in the morning on waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद से जागते ही पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind se jagte hi pasina aata hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: You sweat in the morning after breakfast.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: सुबह नाश्ता करने के बाद पसीना आता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: subah nashta karne ke baad pasina aata hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: You sweat in the morning after drinking coffee.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: सुबह चाय या कॉफी पीने के बाद पसीना आता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: subah chai ya coffee pine ke baad pasina aata hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You sweat in the morning before your menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: सुबह माहवारी से पहले पसीना आता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Subah mahwari se pehle pasina aata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Sweating gets better when you move around.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हिलने-डुलने से पसीना कम हो जाता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hilne-dulne se pasina kam ho jata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Moving around brings on a chilly feeling when you are sweating.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हिलने-डुलने पर पसीने के साथ ठंड लगने लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hilne-dulne par pasine ke saath thandi lagne lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Moving around makes your sweating worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हिलने-डुलने पर पसीना बढ़ जाता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hilne-dulne par pasina badh jata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Perspiration, motion, on making any, sweat disappears and heat comes on
Triggered by specific actions.en: When you make any movement, the sweating stops and you feel hot instead.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: जब भी थोड़ा हिलना-डुलना हो तो पसीना बंद हो जाता है और उसकी जगह गर्मी आ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Jab bhi thoda hilna-dulna ho to pasina band ho jata hai aur uski jagah garmi aa jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat at 10 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को ठीक 10 बजे पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko thik 10 baje pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat at 10 p.m. during a chilly episode.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 10 बजे ठंड लगने के साथ-साथ पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat 10 baje thandi lagne ke saath-saath pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, night, 10 p.m., lasting until morning
Linked to time of day.en: You start sweating at 10 p.m. and it lasts through until morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 10 बजे पसीना शुरू होता है और सुबह तक बना रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat 10 baje pasina shuru hota hai aur subah tak bana rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat from 10 p.m. through to 10 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 10 बजे से सुबह 10 बजे तक पसीना आता रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat 10 baje se subah 10 baje tak pasina aata rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat at 11 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 11 बजे पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat 11 baje pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, night, alternating with dryness of skin
Linked to time of day.en: Your skin alternates between being sweaty and being dry at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को कभी पसीना आता है और कभी त्वचा एकदम सूखी हो जाती है, यह बारी-बारी से होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko kabhi pasina aata hai aur kabhi tvcha ekdum sukhi ho jati hai, yeh bari-bari se hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat at night during fever-free periods.
Linked to time of day.hi: जब बुखार उतरा हुआ होता है उस समय भी रात को पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Jab bukhar utra hua hota hai us samay bhi raat ko pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat every other night, not every night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को पसीना एक रात आता है और अगली रात नहीं, यह एक रात छोड़कर होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko pasina ek raat aata hai aur agli raat nahi, yeh ek raat chhodkar hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat at night when you feel hot.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बुखार की गर्मी के दौरान पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko bukhar ki garmi ke dauran pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, night, lasting all night without relief
Linked to time of day.en: You sweat all night long with no let-up.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात भर पसीना आता रहता है और कोई आराम नहीं मिलता।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat bhar pasina aata rehta hai aur koi aaram nahi milta.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, night, lasting all night, with loquacity
Linked to time of day.en: You sweat all night long and feel talkative throughout.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात भर पसीना आता रहता है और साथ ही बहुत ज़्यादा बातें करने का मन होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat bhar pasina aata rehta hai aur saath hi bahut zyada baatein karne ka man hota hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, night, long lasting musty night sweats
Linked to time of day.en: You have long-lasting, musty-smelling night sweats.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को पसीना आता है जिसमें बासी या पुरानी गंध होती है और यह काफी देर तक रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko pasina aata hai jishmein basi ya purani gandh hoti hai aur yeh kaafi der tak rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat at night during sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद के दौरान पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko nind ke dauran pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat at night during a heavy, dull sleep you can't fully wake from.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को जब बहुत गहरी और भारी नींद आती है तब पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko jab bahut gehri aur bhari nind ati hai tab pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You sweat at night when you wake up.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को जब नींद खुलती है तब पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko jab nind khulti hai tab pasina aata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Perspiration, night, covering ever so little, when
Triggered by specific actions.en: You start sweating at night as soon as you pull even a small amount of covers over yourself.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: रात को थोड़ा-सा भी ओढ़ने पर पसीना आने लगता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Raat ko thoda-sa bhi odhne par pasina ane lagta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: You sweat at night after lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को लेटने के बाद पसीना आता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko letne ke baad pasina aata hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Night sweating is connected to your menstrual period in general.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दिनों में या उससे जुड़े समय में रात को पसीना आता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahvari ke dinon mein ya usse jude samay mein raat ko pasina aata hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You sweat at night before your menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले रात को पसीना आता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahvari ane se pehle raat ko pasina aata hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You sweat at night during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान रात को पसीना आता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahvari ke dauran raat ko pasina aata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Perspiration, night, miliary itching eruption, with
Comes with other symptoms.en: You sweat at night and have an itchy, pimply rash at the same time.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: रात को पसीने के साथ-साथ त्वचा पर छोटे-छोटे दाने निकलते हैं जिनमें खुजली होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Raat ko pasine ke saath-saath tvcha par chhote-chhote dane nikltey hain jinmein khujli hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You sweat at night and feel mentally dull or semi-conscious at the same time.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: रात को जब बेहोशी जैसी हालत होती है तब पसीना आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Raat ko jab behoshi jaisi halat hoti hai tab pasina aata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You sweat at night and are unable to sleep at the same time.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: रात को जब नींद नहीं आती तब पसीना आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Raat ko jab nind nahi ati tab pasina aata hai.

General.en: Your sweat has a pleasant, spicy or aromatic smell.
General.hi: पसीने में खुशबू जैसी महक आती है।
General.roman: Pasine mein khushboo jaisi mehk aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat smells like blood.
General.hi: पसीने से खून जैसी गंध आती है।
General.roman: Pasine se khun jaisi gandh aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat has a burnt smell.
General.hi: पसीने में जली हुई चीज़ जैसी गंध आती है।
General.roman: Pasine mein jali hui cheez jaisi gandh aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat has a corpse-like or death-like smell.
General.hi: पसीने में सड़े हुए शव जैसी बहुत बुरी गंध आती है।
General.roman: Pasine mein sade hue shav jaisi bahut buri gandh aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat has a cheesy smell.
General.hi: पसीने में पनीर या दही जैसी गंध आती है।
General.roman: Pasine mein panir ya dahi jaisi gandh aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat smells like the medication you have been taking.
General.hi: पसीने में उस दवाई जैसी गंध आती है जो ली जा रही हो।
General.roman: Pasine mein us davai jaisi gandh aati hai jo li ja rahi ho.

General.en: Your sweat smells like rotten eggs.
General.hi: पसीने में सड़े हुए अंडे जैसी गंध आती है।
General.roman: Pasine mein sade hue ande jaisi gandh aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat smells like elderflower blossoms.
General.hi: पसीने में बड़े (elderflower) के फूलों जैसी महक आती है।
General.roman: Pasine mein bade ke phoolon jaisi mehk aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat has a foul or rotten smell.
General.hi: पसीने में बहुत बुरी बदबू आती है।
General.roman: Pasine mein bahut buri badbu aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat smells like honey.
General.hi: पसीने में शहद जैसी मीठी महक आती है।
General.roman: Pasine mein shahad jaisi mithi mehk aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat smells like musk.
General.hi: पसीने में कस्तूरी जैसी महक आती है।
General.roman: Pasine mein kasturi jaisi mehk aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat has a stale, musty smell.
General.hi: पसीने में बासी या सीलन जैसी गंध आती है।
General.roman: Pasine mein basi ya silan jaisi gandh aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat has an unpleasant, offensive smell.
General.hi: पसीने में बदबू आती है।
General.roman: Pasine mein badbu aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat has a putrid, rotting smell.
General.hi: पसीने में सड़ी हुई चीज़ जैसी गंध आती है।
General.roman: Paseene mein sadi hui cheez jaisi gandh aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat has a strong, sharp, unpleasant smell.
General.hi: पसीने में बहुत तेज़ और कड़ी बदबू आती है।
General.roman: Paseene mein bahut tez aur kadi badboo aati hai.

General.en: Your sweat has a sickly, nauseating smell.
General.hi: पसीने में ऐसी गंध आती है जो मन को उबकाई दे।
General.roman: Paseene mein aisi gandh aati hai jo man ko ubkai de.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, odor, bitter in the morning
Linked to time of day.en: Your sweat smells bitter, especially in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह पसीने में कड़वी गंध आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah pasine mein kadvi gandh aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sweat smells offensive in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद पसीने में बदबू आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad pasine mein badbu aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sweat smells offensive in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय पसीने में बदबू आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay paseene mein badboo aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sweat smells offensive at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को पसीने में बदबू आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko paseene mein badboo aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, odor, offensive, night, during sleep
Linked to time of day.en: Your sweat smells offensive at night during sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को सोते समय पसीने में बदबू आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko sote samay paseene mein badboo aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sweat smells offensive at midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात के बारह बजे के आसपास पसीने में बदबू आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ke barah baje ke aaspas paseene mein badboo aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, odor, rancid, smelling at night
Linked to time of day.en: Your sweat has a rancid smell at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को पसीने में बासी तेल जैसी तेज़ गंध आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko paseene mein basi tel jaisi tez gandh aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: Your sweat has a strong smell that comes along with a skin rash or eruption.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पसीने में गंध आती है और साथ ही त्वचा पर दाने भी निकले हुए हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Pasine mein gandh aati hai aur saath hi tvcha par dane bhi nikle hue hain.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Your sweat smells foul or rotten after coughing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाँसने के बाद पसीने में बहुत बुरी बदबू आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khanste ke baad pasine mein bahut buri badbu aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Your sweat smells offensive after coughing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाँसी के बाद पसीने में बदबू आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khansi ke baad pasine mein badbu aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Your sweat smells offensive when you exert yourself physically.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: मेहनत या कसरत करने पर पसीने में बदबू आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Mehnat ya kasrat karne par paseene mein badboo aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Your sweat smells offensive when you move around.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हिलने-डुलने पर पसीने में बदबू आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hilne-dulne par paseene mein badboo aati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your sweat smells offensive during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान पसीने में बदबू आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran paseene mein badboo aati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your sweat has a strong, sharp smell during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान पसीने में बहुत तेज़ और कड़ी बदबू आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran paseene mein bahut tez aur kadi badboo aati hai.

Specific body area.path: Perspiration, odor, offensive, on one side
Specific body area.en: The sweat on one side of your body smells offensive but not the other side.
Specific body area.hi: शरीर के एक तरफ के पसीने में बदबू आती है।
Specific body area.roman: Sharir ke ek taraf ke paseene mein badboo aati hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat has a smoky smell.
Discharge.hi: पसीने में धुएँ जैसी गंध आती है।
Discharge.roman: Paseene mein dhue jaisi gandh aati hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat has a sour smell.
Discharge.hi: पसीने में खट्टी गंध आती है।
Discharge.roman: Paseene mein khatti gandh aati hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat has a sour smell in the afternoon.
Discharge.hi: दोपहर बाद पसीने में खट्टी गंध आती है।
Discharge.roman: Dopahar baad paseene mein khatti gandh aati hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat has a sour smell in the late morning (before noon).
Discharge.hi: दोपहर से पहले सुबह के वक्त पसीने में खट्टी गंध आती है।
Discharge.roman: Dopahar se pehle subah ke wakt paseene mein khatti gandh aati hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat has a sour smell in the morning.
Discharge.hi: सुबह पसीने में खट्टी गंध आती है।
Discharge.roman: Subah paseene mein khatti gandh aati hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat has a sour smell at night.
Discharge.hi: रात को पसीने में खट्टी गंध आती है।
Discharge.roman: Raat ko paseene mein khatti gandh aati hai.

Discharge.path: Perspiration, odor, sour, night, sleep, during
Discharge.en: My sweat has a sour smell at night while I am asleep.
Discharge.hi: रात को सोते समय पसीने में खट्टी गंध आती है।
Discharge.roman: Raat ko sote samay paseene mein khatti gandh aati hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat has a spicy smell.
Discharge.hi: पसीने में मसाले जैसी तीखी महक आती है।
Discharge.roman: Pasiine mein masale jaisi teekhi mehak aati hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat smells like sulphur (like rotten eggs).
Discharge.hi: पसीने में गंधक (सल्फर) जैसी गंध आती है।
Discharge.roman: Pasiine mein gandhak jaisi gandh aati hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat has a sweetish smell.
Discharge.hi: पसीने में हल्की-सी मीठी गंध आती है।
Discharge.roman: Pasiine mein halki-si meethi gandh aati hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat smells like urine.
Discharge.hi: पसीने में पेशाब जैसी गंध आती है।
Discharge.roman: Pasiine mein peshaab jaisi gandh aati hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat smells just like urine.
Discharge.hi: पसीने की गंध बिल्कुल पेशाब जैसी होती है।
Discharge.roman: Pasiine ki gandh bilkul peshaab jaisi hoti hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat smells like horse urine.
Discharge.hi: पसीने की गंध घोड़े के पेशाब जैसी होती है।
Discharge.roman: Pasiine ki gandh ghode ke peshaab jaisi hoti hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat is oily or greasy during the day.
Discharge.hi: दिन के समय पसीना चिकना या तैलीय होता है।
Discharge.roman: Din ke samay pasina chikna ya tailiy hota hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat is oily or greasy in the morning.
Discharge.hi: सुबह के समय पसीना चिकना या तैलीय होता है।
Discharge.roman: Subah ke samay pasina chikna ya tailiy hota hai.

Discharge.en: My sweat is oily or greasy at night.
Discharge.hi: रात को पसीना चिकना या तैलीय होता है।
Discharge.roman: Raat ko pasina chikna ya tailiy hota hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: After my pain goes away, I break out in a sweat.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दर्द खत्म होने के बाद पसीना आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Dard khatm hone ke baad pasina aata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: The pain causes me to sweat.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दर्द की वजह से पसीना आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Dard ki wajah se pasina aata hai.

General.en: I sweat heavily on the parts of my body that are affected by my illness.
General.hi: जो हिस्सा बीमार है उस जगह बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है।
General.roman: Jo hissa bimar hai us jagah bahut zyada pasina aata hai.

General.en: I only sweat heavily while I am awake.
General.hi: जब तक जागते हैं तभी बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है, सोने पर बंद हो जाता है।
General.roman: Jab tak jagte hain tabhi bahut zyada pasina aata hai, sone par band ho jata hai.

General.en: I sweat heavily on the parts of my body that are covered.
General.hi: शरीर के ढके हुए हिस्सों पर बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
General.roman: Sharir ke dhke hue hisson par bahut zyada pasina aata hai.

General.path: Perspiration, profuse, day and night without relief
General.en: I sweat heavily all day and all night without any relief.
General.hi: दिन-रात लगातार बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता रहता है और कोई राहत नहीं मिलती
General.roman: Din-rat lagatar bahut zyada pasina aata rahta hai aur koi rahat nahi milti.

General.en: I sweat so heavily that it makes me weak and exhausted.
General.hi: इतना ज़्यादा पसीना आता है कि शरीर कमज़ोर हो जाता है
General.roman: Itna zyada pasina aata hai ki sharir kamzor ho jata hai.

General.en: I sweat so heavily that it makes me weak and exhausted, and the sweat has a bad smell.
General.hi: बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है जो बदबूदार भी होता है और उससे कमज़ोरी भी आती है
General.roman: Bahut zyada pasina aata hai jo badbuddar bhi hota hai aur usse kamzori bhi aati hai.

General.en: I sweat heavily but it does not make me feel weak or exhausted.
General.hi: बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है लेकिन उससे कमज़ोरी नहीं होती
General.roman: Bahut zyada pasina aata hai lekin usse kamzori nahi hoti.

General.en: I sweat heavily while I am asleep.
General.hi: नींद के दौरान बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
General.roman: nind ke dauran bahut zyada pasina ata hai

General.path: Perspiration, profuse, uncovered parts, on, except the head
General.en: I sweat heavily on the parts of my body that are uncovered, except for my head.
General.hi: शरीर के खुले हिस्सों पर पसीना आता है, सिर को छोड़कर
General.roman: sharir ke khule hisson par pasina ata hai, sir ko chhod kar

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad bahut zyada pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily during an afternoon nap or sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद की नींद के दौरान बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad ki neend ke dauran bahut zyada pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily in the afternoon along with a feeling of heat.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद गर्मी के साथ बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad garmi ke saath bahut zyada pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily while asleep during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन में नींद के दौरान बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: Din mein neend ke dauran bahut zyada pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के वक्त बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ke wakt bahut zyada pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, profuse, evening, 7 p.m., lasting till 1 a.m. dry heat returns on going to sleep
Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily starting around 7 in the evening and it lasts until about 1 in the morning, then when I fall back asleep a dry heat comes back instead of sweating.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को लगभग 7 बजे से बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना शुरू होता है और रात 1 बजे तक रहता है, फिर सोने पर सूखी गर्मी वापस आ जाती है
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko lagbhag 7 baje se bahut zyada pasina shuru hota hai aur rat 1 baje tak rehta hai, phir sone par sukhi garmi wapas aa jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily every other evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: एक दिन छोड़कर शाम को बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: Ek din chhodkar sham ko bahut zyada pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, profuse, evening, lasting all night
Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily starting in the evening and it continues all night.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को शुरू होकर पूरी रात बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता रहता है
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko shuru hokar puri rat bahut zyada pasina aata rahta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के वक्त बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: subah ke waqt bahut zyada pasina aata hai

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily in the morning while still in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बिस्तर में लेटे-लेटे बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: subah bistar mein lete-lete bahut zyada pasina aata hai

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily in the morning, and the sweat is hot and dry.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह गर्म और सूखा पसीना बहुत ज़्यादा आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: subah garam aur sukha pasina bahut zyada aata hai

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, profuse, morning, lasting all day
Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily in the morning and it continues all day long.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह शुरू होकर पूरे दिन बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता रहता है
Linked to time of day.roman: subah shuru hokar pure din bahut zyada pasina aata rahta hai

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily in the morning while I am asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद के दौरान बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: subah nind ke dauran bahut zyada pasina aata hai

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily in the morning after waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलने के बाद बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: subah nind khulne ke baad bahut zyada pasina aata hai

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko bahut zyada pasina aata hai

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily at night after 3 in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 3 बजे के बाद बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko 3 baje ke baad bahut zyada pasina aata hai

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily at night after 4 in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 4 बजे के बाद बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko 4 baje ke baad bahut zyada pasina aata hai

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, profuse, night, every alternate night
Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily every other night.
Linked to time of day.hi: एक रात छोड़कर रात को बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: ek raat chhod kar raat ko bahut zyada pasina aata hai

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily at night around midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat ko bahut zyada pasina aata hai

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily at night after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat ke baad bahut zyada pasina aata hai

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily at night before midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat se pehle bahut zyada pasina aata hai

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, profuse, night, midnight, lasting until morning
Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily at night starting at midnight and it continues until morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से शुरू होकर सुबह तक बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता रहता है
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat se shuru hokar subah tak bahut zyada pasina aata rahta hai

Linked to time of day.path: Perspiration, profuse, night, on waking the sweat ceases, and returns again on falling asleep
Linked to time of day.en: At night, when I wake up the sweating stops, but as soon as I fall asleep again the sweating comes back.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद खुलने पर पसीना बंद हो जाता है और दोबारा सोने पर फिर आने लगता है
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko nind khulne par pasina band ho jata hai aur dobara sone par phir aane lagta hai

Linked to time of day.en: I sweat heavily at night while I am asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद में बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko nind mein bahut zyada pasina aata hai

Comes with other symptoms.en: I sweat heavily after a strong, congested chill.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड लगने का दौरा खत्म होने के बाद बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi lagne ka daura khatm hone ke baad bahut zyada pasina aata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: I sweat so heavily that it makes me weak and exhausted, and this happens during episodes of confusion or delirium.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बेहोशी या भ्रम की हालत में बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है और उससे कमज़ोरी होती है
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Behoshi ya bhram ki halat mein bahut zyada pasina aata hai aur usse kamzori hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Perspiration, profuse, debilitating, diarrhea, with and copious flow of urine
Comes with other symptoms.en: I sweat so heavily that it makes me weak and exhausted, and this happens alongside loose stools (diarrhea) and passing large amounts of urine.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बहुत ज़्यादा पसीना आता है जिससे कमज़ोरी होती है, साथ में दस्त और पेशाब भी खूब होता है
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Bahut zyada pasina aata hai jisse kamzori hoti hai, sath mein dast aur peshab bhi khub hota hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: I sweat heavily when I am short of breath or having trouble breathing.
